keep-east-gate.title: 1-2 · The east gate
keep-east-gate.description: Two 30 ft towers and a 20 ft gatehouse working the drawbridge, all granite, with arrow slits.

keep-entry-court.title: 3 · Entry courtyard
keep-entry-court.players: Cobbles and bright banners. The watch corporal tells you to dismount and stable your mounts.

keep-stables.title: 4 · Common stables
keep-stables.description: d6+3 stable-boys and attendants. d6-1 each of light courier horses, draft horses and mules, besides the party's mounts.

keep-warehouse.title: 5 · Common warehouse
keep-warehouse.description: Anything that cannot reasonably be carried, and any valuables, must be kept here while staying at the keep.

keep-bailiff.title: 6 · The bailiff's tower
keep-bailiff.description: The bailiff keeps the peace in the public keep: a 3rd-level warrior and minor noble in mastercraft +1 plate (defense 4) with a mastercraft +1 longsword. (Not yet in the creature list.)

keep-apartments.title: 7 · Private apartments
keep-apartments.description: Five well-furnished apartments for merchants and noble visitors, two more by the courtyard.

keep-smithy.title: 8 · The blacksmith
keep-smithy.description: She can craft common or uncommon magic items, but haggling with her is an exercise in frustration. Going through the trader smooths it over and doubles the price.

keep-general-store.title: 9 · General store
keep-general-store.description: Any reasonable mundane adventuring gear at standard prices. Arms and armour: next door.

keep-trader.title: 10 · The trader's shop
keep-trader.description: Fine clothing and the blacksmith's arms and armour; commissions in 2-3 days (plate or barding 1-2 weeks). Buys furs, hides, cloth, gold and jewellery for the seamstress wife.

keep-courtyard.title: 13 · Main courtyard and fountain
keep-courtyard.players: Wide ornate brickwork around a large fountain.

keep-inn.title: 14 · The travellers' inn
keep-inn.description: Five private rooms at 1 drac a night; a common room of twelve bunks at a dime a bed.

keep-tavern.title: 15 · The tavern
keep-tavern.description: At least 3d6 patrons at any hour. Meals 1-5 dimes, drink 5 pennies to a drac. The family's three children serve. Buy the barkeep a drink for a rumour (the d6 table in the text).

keep-guild.title: 16 · Merchant guild headquarters
keep-guild.description: Will pay a handsome reward for the missing merchant (held in the caves at F24).

keep-banker-house.title: 7a · The banker's house
keep-banker-house.description: If bothered at home they gruffly send the party to the bank during business hours.

keep-priest-house.title: 7b · The visiting priest
keep-priest-house.description: A charming scholar-priest, eager to discuss Crom Cruach and to volunteer as a guide. Secretly a warlock of the cult: he will lead the party into the labyrinth at I and offer them to the baal-malak.

keep-chapel.title: 17 · The chapel
keep-chapel.description: The priests keep the whole keep hallowed ground.

keep-inner-gate.title: 18 · Inner gatehouse
keep-inner-gate.description: Visitors need special permission to pass. If Sir Edward is persuaded, nine guards and the sergeant may go with the party to the caves.

keep-watchtowers.title: 19-20 · Watchtowers
keep-watchtowers.description: Six guards in each, two on post at the top. The larger tower (20) mounts a ballista.

keep-inner-bailey.title: 21 · The inner bailey
keep-inner-bailey.description: By day, at least two ten-man ranks of guards drill on the grass.

keep-cavalry-stables.title: 22 · Cavalry stables
keep-cavalry-stables.description: Thirty warhorses, d6 light courier horses, two stable hands.

keep-great-tower.title: 23 · The great tower
keep-great-tower.description: The storm cannon, an artifact siege weapon brought from Albion against dragons and ogres. The engineers never stop repairing it.

keep-fortress.title: 24 · The fortress
keep-fortress.description: Steel doors 20 ft wide and 15 ft high; a courtyard, great hall and armory inside. Guards' quarters (26) and the castellan's quarters (27) are on top.
keep-fortress.wants: Sir Edward sees the beastfolk and lizardfolk across the river as the real threat and will not leave the keep undefended on a rumour.

keep-cliff-towers.title: 25 · Thunder-rattler towers
keep-cliff-towers.description: Each holds a thunder rattler against raiders climbing the cliff.

keep-lift.title: 28 · The lift beneath the mountain
keep-lift.description: A secret lift down to the Siege Perilous (+2 keen longsword, +3 mirror shield, thunder pinions), kept by a dwarf crew: seven dweomersmiths, twelve stalwarts, three delvers. They help with nothing else. (Golem and dwarves not yet in the creature list.)
